# looot-csv-enrich

> Add company, work email, email check, phone and job title columns to any CSV. Prints a quote first; spends only with --run, inside a budget. Built on the looot API.

looot is one key and one prepaid balance for 2,500+ data API endpoints from 90+ providers. Each cell is one job run with fallback across providers; a failed call costs $0.

## Use

- git clone https://github.com/loootai/looot-csv-enrich && cd looot-csv-enrich
- node src/cli.ts leads.csv --add company,email,verify            (quote, free, no token)
- LOOOT_TOKEN=... node src/cli.ts leads.csv --add company,email,verify --budget 2 --run

## Links

- Docs: https://docs.looot.ai
- Remote MCP server: claude mcp add --transport http looot https://api.looot.ai/mcp
- GTM tools list: https://github.com/loootai/awesome-gtm
